features.name: Horns
features.description: Your horns are natural weapons. Your unarmed strikes with them deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

features.name: Mirthful Leaps
features.description: Whenever you make a long jump or high jump, roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you can cover. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

features.name: Reveler
features.description: You have proficiency in the Performance and Persuasion skills, and proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.
